I’ve been using Pet Parlour for the past four years, and I couldn’t be happier with the service. The quality of the food has always been excellent, and my dog loves their very own Kaya brand.

What really stands out is the prompt delivery. Every order arrives quickly and on time, which gives me peace of mind knowing I won’t run out of food. The whole ordering process is straightforward, and if I’ve ever needed assistance, it’s been completely hassle-free.

After four years as a customer, I can confidently recommend this company to anyone looking for reliable service, fast delivery, and a stress-free experience.

Great choice of products, first class customer service. Paddy can get you something that's not on the website (Yumove Joint) and delivery day with James is always a joy for the dogs. We love the Pet Parlour.
Outstanding service all around. Online orders are dispatched incredibly quickly, and friendly, helpful support is always available by phone when needed.
Had a problem with PayPal when I ordered online. Paddy was so helpful, went above & beyond to ensure I got my order. Highly recommended as always!

What a little diamond of a shop, it's not a big franchise who are just after you for your money they actually care, Stephen and his staff will literally go above and beyond to help you they'll even tell you to bring your dog down if you want. Proper advice on everything, the staff are amazing and always on hand, my dog what can I say the difference in him since we went to raw food, from his teeth to his coat and overall muscle and character , one kg of raw food for less than €7? Come on ,dry food with huge amount of meat content or just ordinary dry food and veg the cheapest you'll find. I've told everyone I meet on walks about it like me they travel from tallaght sometimes further to get their food and treats. They then tell me when I see them again how their dogs overall demeanor has changed in just a short few weeks and they'll never go back to their own places. Their prices are excellent you're talking anything from €2-4 difference in dry grain free food and dog  and cat food specials that will last longer, and you know they aren't getting fed crap. You can even bring your dog in  they'll help you out , excellent people I've been going here nearly a year now and I can't believe I'm only putting in my review now 😂. Trust me you won't go back to Maxizoo or other stores,they even do bulk orders with free delivery and you save a lot you get your free raw food pamphlet on switching then over too. Trust me
